raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Lower-right load footprint",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The load is called distributed, but its spatial extent and nodal distribution are unspecified.",
      "readings": [
        "Apply the full downward 1 N force to the lower-right corner node.",
        "Distribute a total downward 1 N uniformly over the lowest right-edge element, giving 0.5 N to each endpoint.",
        "Distribute a total downward 1 N uniformly over the rightmost bottom-edge element, giving 0.5 N to each endpoint."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Fig. 1 caption specifies a downward distributed load at the lower-right corner; Fig. 1(a) shows one arrow without a marked loaded segment."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Young's modulus",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No solid Young's modulus or stiffness normalization is specified.",
      "readings": [
        "Use normalized Young's modulus E = 1.",
        "Use a physical Young's modulus E = 200 GPa."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Section 3.1, Common settings and Eq. (13), specifies linear elasticity through K(rho)u = f without giving E; the Fig. 1 caption supplies no material constants."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The isotropic elastic Poisson's ratio is not specified.",
      "readings": [
        "Use Poisson's ratio 0.30.",
        "Use Poisson's ratio 0.25."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Section 3.1, Common settings and Eq. (13), and the Fig. 1 caption give no Poisson's ratio."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The paper does not identify whether the 2-D elasticity model uses plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Use plane stress.",
        "Use plane strain."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Section 1 identifies Fig. 1 as a 2-D cantilever; Section 3.1 and Eq. (13) specify linear elasticity without stating the planar constitutive assumption."
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No thickness or explicit unit-thickness convention is given for the 2-D model.",
      "readings": [
        "Use unit thickness t = 1 in the chosen length units.",
        "Use uniform thickness t = 0.1 in the same length units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Fig. 1(a) and its caption give the in-plane dimensions and 30 by 60 discretization; Section 3.1 gives no thickness for this example."
    }
  ]
}
